LanguageData.Gun_MP-40_RWP.description: The MP-40 is a classic submachine gun known for its compact design and ease of handling. With an effective full-auto capability, it offers moderate damage and rapid fire, making it ideal for close-quarters combat. Its reliability and iconic silhouette make it a popular choice among colonists who prioritize versatility and portability in combat scenarios.
